source: Real captures of the pinned Codex 0.164.0 (openai/codex rust-v0.164.0, commit 6aaac694803004a63c6f393d153c96d22521a6b9) against the loopback Responses stub of crates/cli/tests/support/responses_stub.rs, with a probe command registered as the hook of each event below. The probe test is a_real_codex_produces_the_committed_subagent_hook_sequences in crates/cli/tests/codex_subagent_sequences.rs.

format.key_sets: The sorted top-level keys of each hook input the probe saw. `UserPromptSubmit (child)` is a UserPromptSubmit that carries an agent_id.
format.path_relations: How the transcript paths of the hook inputs relate, checked in every flow that records the events: the SubagentStart transcript_path is the child's own (it differs from the root session's), the SubagentStop transcript_path is the root session's and its agent_transcript_path is the child's.
format.sequences: One entry per flow. `root_events` is the hook events of the root agent in order, `child_events` those that carry the child's agent_id, in order. The two lists are not ordered against each other. Every child event of a flow carries the same agent_id. `events` is the SubagentStart and SubagentStop inputs of the flow in order, reduced to hook_event_name, agent_id and agent_type, with the synthetic id `agent-child-1` for the one child. No transcript, prompt, path or real id is kept.
format.tools: The multi-agent tool family the flow drives: multi_agent_v1 (spawn_agent, send_input, wait_agent, close_agent, resume_agent) or multi_agent_v2 (spawn_agent, followup_task, interrupt_agent, list_agents, wait_agent; `multi_agent_v2 = true` under [features]).

spawn_complete.description: The root spawns one child and waits for it: SubagentStart, the child's own UserPromptSubmit for its task, then one SubagentStop.

followup_v1.description: A second task reaches the finished child through send_input: the child's UserPromptSubmit fires again and its second turn ends in a second SubagentStop with the same agent_id and no second SubagentStart.

followup_v2.description: The follow-up goes through followup_task of the multi_agent_v2 tools: the child fires no UserPromptSubmit at all, and its second turn ends in a second SubagentStop with no second SubagentStart.

resume_after_close.description: The root closes a finished child, resumes it and sends it a task: the resumed child fires a UserPromptSubmit and a SubagentStop but no SubagentStart.

interrupted_v1.description: The root sends a task with interrupt=true to a child whose turn is running: the interrupted turn ends with no SubagentStop; the redirected turn fires a UserPromptSubmit and ends in the only SubagentStop.

interrupted_v2.description: The root calls interrupt_agent on a child whose turn is running: the child ends with no SubagentStop and no later hook.

close_running_v1.description: The root closes a child whose turn is running: close_agent fires no subagent hook, so the child has a SubagentStart and a UserPromptSubmit and never a SubagentStop.
